**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/09 (Thu) 19:42
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] An app could keep job seekers coming back by offering resources for career development, networking opportunities, personalized job recommendations, interview preparation, salary information, and employee reviews.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Examples of networking opportunities a job board app could offer include professional communities, discussion forums, career events, mentorship programs, alumni networks, and professional groups.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular job board apps that offer networking opportunities include LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, Monster, and ZipRecruiter.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] ZipRecruiter has grown in popularity due to its ease of use, wide reach, effective matching algorithm, affordability, and marketing efforts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] New features and resources added by ZipRecruiter include a resume database, interview scheduling, salary comparisons, career resources, AI-powered job recommendations, and employer branding tools.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Employer branding tools offered by ZipRecruiter include company profiles, employer reviews, customized branding, video job descriptions, and employee testimonials.
